title: Reither See Reith im Alpbachtal
highlights: Centrally situated swimming lake right in the heart of Reith im Alpbachtal
Well-tended sunbathing lawn with shade-giving trees and wooden jetties
Family-friendly leisure amenities with adventure playground and diving board
Ideal starting point for strolls around the award-winning floral village
kurzbeschreibung: Reither See in the heart of Reith im Alpbachtal offers a wonderfully situated family lido with panoramic views.
beschreibung:
Bathing Fun in the Flower Village

The Reither See is a natural gem right in the picturesque village center of Reith im Alpbachtal. Covering a water surface of nearly 1.5 hectares, this moor lake provides refreshing recreation and exceptionally clean swimming enjoyment against the backdrop of the Kitzbüheler Alpen.

Family Lido with Great Comfort

The lido features spacious sunbathing lawns, a separate children's area, a one-meter diving board, and rentals for rowboats and stand-up paddleboards. A cozy lakeside buffet caters to bathers with cool refreshments, ice cream, and regional snacks throughout a sunny day by the water.
